text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"This is the petting park everyone's 
talking about...! Which means the one 
appearing in this book—"

text_block_list.name: Zoo Lady
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to hold a hedgehog too, 
little lady? Make sure you cuddle it 
gently!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Um, well... H-Hello, Mr. Hedgehog. 
I-I'll hold you very gently, okay? So――

text_block_list.name: Zoo Lady
text_block_list.text:
H-Huuh!? I'm so sorry~! He's usually so 
friendly, I wonder what's gotten into 
him~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, without ever getting to interact 
with her intended hedgehog, Zenno Rob 
Roy's day off came to an end...
